generic_sampling_rules.integer_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL; never plant duplicates or ties on a primary-key column.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_foreign_key: Sample from the union of the parent table's compact (original) primary-key values and its generated primary-key values; every generated child FK value must exist in that union. Include at least one child row per parent key and at least one parent key with no children; nullable FKs also get NULL rows.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer in the observed range; include boundary values at each listed literal and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real in the observed range rounded to 2 decimals; include boundary values at each listed literal and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.short_text_enum: Sample from the observed distinct values; include near-variants (case changes) of listed equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.free_text: Sample from the observed distinct values; include near-variants (case changes) of listed equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_column: With probability equal to the compact database's NULL share for that column (at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance), emit NULL; otherwise sample a non-NULL value. When the compact share is 0, still emit at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance.
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_column: Ensure the duplicate share of the column stays in the 20-50% band by repeating some values; never apply to a primary-key column.
generic_sampling_rules.order_limit_column: Ensure ties at the listed LIMIT rank by repeating the boundary value at that rank.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_column: Ensure groups of size 1, 2 and >= 3 exist for the column; distribute planted values across distinct rows so variation is preserved.

supporting_evidence.query_derived_literals: market_share boundary literals 3.99..15.01 and string literals 'Internet Explorer'/'internet explorer'/'Opera'/'opera'/'CACHEbox'/'cachebox' are query-derived, not observed column values.
supporting_evidence.null_shares: Compact database shows zero NULLs in every nullable column; the nullable_column rule therefore emits at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance while following the compact share (0) otherwise.
supporting_evidence.fk_integrity: Review feedback: generated instances had 18 FK violations because shaping wrote child FK values not present in the parent key set. Revised rule: all child FK values are drawn from the union of compact and generated parent keys; unmatched-join shaping creates parent rows without children instead of orphan child rows.

uncertainty: The observed sample is small; ranges for market_share and compatible_since_year are widened beyond the observed min/max to allow boundary and near-boundary values. No calculated-column formula is supported by the shown rows. Primary-key duplicate/tie patterns from the atomic summary are dropped because they conflict with primary-key uniqueness. Several per-column targets (market_share boundary literals, tie at rank 10, browser.id group sizes, Web_client_accelerator.id aggregate/group sizes, browser_id aggregate boundary) are marked aspirational because they cannot all be satisfied at the fixed table sizes; mandatory targets are those achievable within the row budget. Exact compact NULL shares per nullable column were not provided; the program falls back to 0.15/0 for several columns.
